How to Draw a Dog

Easy Drawing for Kids in 6 Steps

Six big steps from one circle to a finished dog. All you need is paper, a pencil and your favorite colors — crayons work too.

Step 1 of 6

You drew a dog!

Draw a cat next Back to Activities

For grown-ups: Sit together and draw side by side. A wobbly circle makes the friendliest dog. Paper, a pencil and something to color with are all this lesson needs.
